site.math.description: Laga bilaabo heerka hoose ilaa heerka sare, bar fikirka xisaabta ee wax ku ool ah iyo xalinta dhibaatooyinka nolosha dhabta ah adigoo isticmaalaya hawlo xiiso leh.
site.english.description: Wax ka sii badan diyaarinta imtixaanka—baro Ingiriisi wax ku ool ah oo loogu talagalay wada hadalka maalinlaha ah, horumarinta shaqada, ganacsiga, iyo safarka adduunka adigoo isticmaalaya hawlo gaagaaban.
site.korean.description: Laga bilaabo xarfaha Hangul ilaa Af-Kuuriyaanka ganacsiga, fur fursado iyo xiriirro cusub adigoo isticmaalaya casharro lagu sharaxay afkaaga hooyo.

modes.title: Dooro habka dib-u-eegista
modes.intro: Dib u eeg isla maaddadan siyaabo kala duwan. Su'aalaha heerarka aad hore u gaadhay oo keliya ayaa soo muuqda.
modes.choice.desc: Ka dooro jawaabta saxda ah doorashooyinka.
modes.listening.desc: Dhegayso jumlad oo ka dooro mid la mid ah doorashooyinka.
modes.order.desc: Ku hagaaji qaybaha erayada sida ay u habboon tahay. Habayn kale oo dabiici ah sidoo kale way saxnaan kartaa.
modes.dictation.desc: Qor jumladda aad maqlayso sida saxda ah. Higgaadda waa inay sax noqotaa; Ingiriisiga, xarfaha waaweyn iyo meelaha dheeraadka ah ama calaamadaha waa la dhaafi karaa. Meelaha u dhexeeya erayada Kuuriyaanka lama dhaafo.
modes.noSound: Haddii aadan maqli karin cod, dib u eeg adigoo isticmaalaya “Ka dooro doorashooyin” ama “Ku hagaaji”. Dejinta codka iyo caawinta waxay ku jiraan profile-kaaga.
modes.cards.desc: Arag dhanka hore ee eray, xasuuso macnihiisa, kadibna hubi dhanka dambe. Tani ma saameyso XP, heerka ama jadwalka dib-u-eegista.
cards.local: Calaamadaha “Waan ogaa / Mar kale” waxaa lagu kaydiyaa qalabkan oo keliya, mana beddelaan XP ama jadwalka dib-u-eegista.

tts.help.check.browser: Browser-yada ku jira apps kale waxaa laga yaabaa inay ku hadli waayaan. Boggan ku fur browser-ka caadiga ah ee taleefanka (Safari, Chrome, Edge).
tts.help.ios: iPhone / iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices, dooro {lang} oo soo deji cod.
tts.help.android: Android: Settings → Language & input (ama General management) → Text-to-speech → voice data, oo rakib {lang}.
tts.help.windows: Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech (ama Language & region) oo ku dar xirmada luuqadda {lang} iyo codka.
tts.help.mac: Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices, oo ku dar cod {lang} ah.

pron.heading: Talo dhawaaqid
pron.final: Dhammaadka eray ama ka hor shaqal-la'aan, shaqal-la'aanta dhammaadka oo ah tense ama aspirated stop, s, j ama ch (noocyada k-, t-, p- iyo sibilants) waxaa loo dhawaaqaa k, t ama p caadi ah, tusaale ahaan {ex}.
pron.liaison: Marka shaqal-la'aan dhammaad ah oo keliya ama laba jibaaran ay raacdo qayb, dhammaad ama suffix ku bilaabma shaqal (oo lagu qoray shaqal-la'aan bilow aan la dhawaaqin), shaqal-la'aanta dhammaadka waxaa loo dhawaaqaa bilowga lixaadka xiga, tusaale ahaan {ex}.
pron.nasal: Cod dhammaad ah oo stop (nooca k, t ama p) ayaa noqda cod sanka ah (ng, n ama m) ka hor shaqal-la'aan sanka ah (n ama m), tusaale ahaan {ex}.
pron.lateral: Marka cod n iyo cod l/r ay ku kulmaan xadka lixaadka, badanaa waxaa loo dhawaaqaa l (waxaa jira waxyaabo yar oo ka reeban), tusaale ahaan {ex}.
pron.tense: Ka dib cod dhammaad ah oo stop (nooca k, t ama p), shaqal-la'aanta caadiga ah ee xigta (nooca g, d, b, s ama j) waxaa loo dhawaaqaa tense, tusaale ahaan {ex}.
pron.source: Il: Standard Pronunciation Rules of Korean, qodobka {art} (National Institute of Korean Language).
pron.note: Taladani waxay sharaxaysaa xeer. Codka qalabkaagu wuxuu ciyaaraa cod oo keliya; app-kani ma xukumo dhawaaqaaga.

think.hub.intro: Ma aha su'aalo jawaab keliya leh: hawlo aad ku miisaanto caddaynta, isbarbar dhigto, saxdo khaladaadka oo aad samayso tusaalayaal aad leedahay. Gooni ka ah casharrada caadiga ah - isku day mar kasta oo aad rabto.
